title: Yandex businessComment responses are dropped
original_report: The internal parser reported August reviews for Весёлая расчёска as unanswered even though the business owner could see responses in Yandex.
discovery_scope: existing parser and response utility tests
expected: A Yandex review containing businessComment is stored with its organization reply and has_response=true.
actual: The parser ignored businessComment and marked the review unanswered.
reproduction: A focused unit test passes a fetchReviews payload whose owner response is stored in businessComment.
failure_signal: Before the fix, org_reply, response_text and response_date were None and has_response was false.
root_cause: The owner-response extractor accepted legacy response keys but omitted Yandex's current businessComment and business_comment keys.
fix_summary: Added businessComment and business_comment to the existing response-key fallback chain.
why_causal: The existing normalization logic already handles the object shape; making the current keys reachable preserves the response text, date and has_response flag.

reproduction_files.summary: Focused regression fixture approved at Gate 1.

checks.name: Focused regression
checks.detail: Same test changed from failing to passing.

checks.name: Relevant parser suite
checks.detail: 12 parser and response utility tests passed.

limitations: The paid Apify full snapshot remains unavailable because its account hard limit is exceeded.
The native live parser currently captures only 50 reviews before stagnation, so it cannot immediately recalculate the entire historical count of 142 reviews.
residual_risks: A live response outside the native parser's first 50 reviews will be corrected only after a complete snapshot becomes available.
notes: No public API or database schema changed.
The failing evidence JSON was transcribed from the approved pre-fix test run because that run preceded capture_command instrumentation.
